conclusions: The report now covers the test day and contains a record for the correct account.
Reported actual added and deleted lines are each 50 percent of the controlled client baseline.
Custom-mode interaction is present; its zero feature-level LoC is not evidence of zero custom-agent edits because actual edits are pooled under agent_edit.
Actual edit LoC is nonzero even though code_acceptance_activity_count and suggestion LoC are zero.
The returned named-custom-agent breakdown is empty, while chat_panel_custom_mode has one interaction; these are distinct fields and cannot be treated as equivalent counters.
attribution_limitations: Reported LoC equals either pair of equal-sized harness cases. This is compatible with only the Local pair being counted, but does not prove that attribution.
The user-day record contains no explicit harness or request-ID breakdown linking actual LoC to individual cases.
The vscode client session count of four is a separate aggregate and does not establish that each of the four controlled cases contributed LoC.
Other same-day activity or later report revisions are not excluded. The shortfall is observed in this snapshot, not proven permanent loss.
